description: Flat metadata schema for individual single-cell amplified genome (SAG) records from uncultured marine microbes, including cell isolation, lysis, amplification, sequencing, assembly, annotation, and quality metrics.

sag_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual SAG record within the dataset or project.

sample_id.descr: Identifier for the original environmental sample or collection event from which the cell was isolated.

project_id.descr: Identifier for the broader project or study, if applicable.

collection_date.descr: Date when the environmental sample was collected (ISO 8601 format, e.g., 2026-08-18).

sample_site_name.descr: Name of the sampling location or station.

water_depth_m.descr: Depth of water column at sampling or cell source depth, in meters.

habitat_type.descr: Marine habitat category, e.g., surface ocean, deep sea, coastal, pelagic, estuarine.

environmental_context.descr: Free-text description of the environmental setting and relevant collection context.

cell_isolation_method.descr: Method used to isolate individual cells, e.g., microfluidics, FACS, micromanipulation.

microfluidic_platform.descr: Specific microfluidic device or platform used for cell isolation, if applicable.

cell_sorting_parameters.descr: Key operating parameters for cell isolation, such as channel size, flow rate, or sort settings.

cell_staining_method.descr: Any stain or fluorescent marker used before isolation, if applicable.

cell_lysis_method.descr: Method used to lyse the isolated cell, e.g., alkaline, thermal, enzymatic, chemical, combined.

lysis_buffer_composition.descr: Composition of the lysis buffer or reagents used, if available.

lysis_temperature_c.descr: Temperature used during lysis, in degrees Celsius.

amplification_method.descr: Whole-genome amplification method, expected to be multiple displacement amplification (MDA) or similar.

amplification_enzyme.descr: Polymerase or amplification enzyme used, e.g., phi29 DNA polymerase.

amplification_protocol.descr: Protocol name or short description for the amplification workflow.

amplification_temperature_c.descr: Incubation temperature during amplification, in degrees Celsius.

amplification_reaction_volume_ul.descr: Reaction volume used for amplification, in microliters.

amplification_input_amount_pg.descr: Estimated DNA input amount from the single cell, in picograms, if known.

amplification_batch_id.descr: Identifier for the amplification batch or plate/well set.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument platform, e.g., Illumina NovaSeq, NextSeq, MiSeq.

sequencing_library_method.descr: Library preparation method used after amplification.

sequencing_run_id.descr: Identifier for the sequencing run, if available.

read_length_bp.descr: Sequencing read length in base pairs.

read_pairing.descr: Whether reads are single-end or paired-end.

raw_read_count.descr: Number of raw sequencing reads generated for this SAG.

raw_bases_bp.descr: Total number of raw bases generated, in base pairs.

quality_filtering_tool.descr: Software used for read quality filtering or trimming.

quality_filtering_version.descr: Version of the quality filtering software.

assembly_strategy.descr: Assembly strategy used, e.g., single-cell assembly, co-assembly, iterative assembly.

assembly_kmer_size.descr: K-mer size used during assembly, if applicable.

assembly_contig_count.descr: Number of contigs in the final assembly.

assembly_total_length_bp.descr: Total assembled genome length, in base pairs.

assembly_n50_bp.descr: N50 statistic for the assembly, in base pairs.

assembly_gc_content_pct.descr: GC content of the assembled genome, expressed as percent.

assembly_max_contig_length_bp.descr: Length of the longest contig, in base pairs.

assembly_completeness_pct.descr: Estimated genome completeness, expressed as percent.

assembly_contamination_pct.descr: Estimated contamination or redundancy, expressed as percent.

assembly_strain_heterogeneity_pct.descr: Estimated strain heterogeneity, expressed as percent, if assessed.

binning_used.descr: Indicates whether binning was applied to the SAG assembly.

binning_method.descr: Binning method or software used, if applicable.

taxonomy_assignment_method.descr: Method used for taxonomic classification, e.g., GTDB-Tk, marker gene analysis.

rrna_16s_present.descr: Indicates whether a 16S rRNA gene was detected in the assembly.

metabolic_pathway_summary.descr: Short free-text summary of notable metabolic pathways or ecological functions inferred from the genome.

ecological_role_inference.descr: Interpretive description of the likely ecological role of the organism, if inferred from genomic content.

qc_pass.descr: Indicates whether the SAG passed predefined quality-control criteria.

qc_notes.descr: Free-text notes on QC issues, exclusions, or caveats.

contig_accession.descr: Primary assembly or contig accession identifier in a public repository, if available.

sra_accession.descr: Raw read accession identifier in a public repository, if available.

assembly_accession.descr: Genome assembly accession identifier in a public repository, if available.
